bull.b: Sustained revenue growth alongside healthy gross margins indicates strong product economics and expanding commercial traction. If maintained, this combination can support reinvestment in the ophthalmic portfolio, improve operating leverage, and strengthen Harrow’s ability to scale its business over the next several quarters.

Adding TYRVAYA broadens Harrow’s dry-eye offering beyond VEVYE and brings an experienced commercial team into the platform. The complementary product and existing distribution footprint could deepen provider relationships, increase portfolio productivity, and create a more durable base for ocular-surface growth.

bull.t: Improving Market Access And Commercial Execution
bull.b: Broader payer coverage can reduce access barriers and make prescription growth more repeatable, while a larger account-focused sales presence improves execution capacity. Together, these changes may expand VEVYE adoption, strengthen physician reach, and support recurring branded revenue beyond a single quarter.

bear.b: Rapidly rising debt combined with shrinking equity materially limits financial flexibility. High leverage can absorb a larger share of operating resources through financing obligations, constrain investment in commercialization and development, and leave Harrow more exposed if growth or profitability falls short.

bear.t: Negative Recent Cash Flow And Profitability
bear.b: The latest reversal from positive 2025 cash generation to negative operating and free cash flow shows that reported growth has not yet translated consistently into internal funding. Combined with renewed net losses, this may require tighter spending, additional financing, or slower investment in future products.

bear.t: Lower Earnings Outlook And Margin Pressure
bear.b: The substantially lower EBITDA outlook indicates that revenue expansion is currently converting into earnings less efficiently than previously expected. Lower product margins and elevated G-MELT, clinical, and TYRVAYA-related costs could keep profitability under pressure and delay the benefits of operating scale.
